verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes clean visual editing as an acceptance condition for the trial clips; the administrative deadline is not encoded.
Replacing the trial clip with screening suspends the current trial-clip editing obligation; it does not make the visual-editing attribute obsolete.
The client requires production clips to follow the current Notion editing-style guidelines and expands the behavior beyond the earlier trial-local scope.
The client defines clean, simple professional editing and explicitly prohibits crazy effects and transitions; the source does not limit the prohibition to flashy transitions.
First concrete failure: the submitted clips contained distracting animations and flashy transitions instead of clean, simple editing.
The corrective instruction explicitly prohibits animations and flashy transitions as part of the clean visual-editing standard.
Matching an entire reference clip is broader than this Requirement and does not specifically identify the clean-versus-distracting visual-editing behavior.
The production instruction retains clean, simple editing while specifying heavy animations and flashy transitions as prohibited; the repeated project scope is not a new scope change.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Before anything else, Nikhil, I owe you an apology for taking so long to respond. Although we had already made our selections, many applicants who were not chosen continued contacting us, and some even offered to work for free just to get an opportunity. I needed to address that properly and respectfully before giving my full attention to the twelve of you we are moving forward with.

You can also be assured that a ticket will be created for you before the deadline, securing your place and ensuring you are paid on time. There is no need to worry about that.

Here is where things stand now:

The group we are building is our first core team. This is more than twelve hires; you are the founding group. As we progress, top performers will move onto our CPM based pay structure and receive bonuses. From this group, one person will step into the Lead Clipper role. That responsibility includes leading the team, approving clips, managing the other clippers, and receiving a stable salary with bonuses on top. The opportunity remains open, and consistency and results will determine who earns it.

Your next steps are as follows:

Before editing anything, carefully review everything in the Notion brand guidelines, including the editing style, hooks, subtitles, and material that must never be clipped. Arden’s personal welcome video is currently being added alongside example videos. Check back later today so you can hear his explanation of the vision behind all of this directly.

After reviewing the guidelines, begin creating your clips. Doing so is what takes you beyond the Upwork trial phase and into the real system.

Additional training resources are still being added to the Notion, so continue checking it as they become available.

I’m excited to have all twelve of you secured. Let’s make sure we build this properly.

— Darius
Audience Production Lead at Emberframe Studio
